Resolves #21938
Related: #21889, #21140

Adds a declarative `header-period` toolbar item in `Neo.calendar.view.MainContainer#createHeaderItems()` bound via `bind:` to `MainContainerStateProvider`'s `headerPeriod` formula and `activeView` state (`Wednesday, July 22, 2026` in Day, `Jul 19 – 25, 2026` / `Jun 28 – Jul 4, 2026` / `Dec 27, 2026 – Jan 2, 2027` in Week, `July 2026` in Month, hidden via `removeDom` in Year), and keys the two-row compact header (`Jul 22, 2026` / `Jul 2026`, aligned below `‹ Today ›`) on `.neo-calendar-maincontainer` `container-type: inline-size` (`@container (max-width: 680px)`) so both phone viewports (`390 × 844`) and narrow resizable windows (`apps/webdesktop`) keep all view and settings buttons unclipped.

- **Change class (`pull-request-workflow.md §3.1`):** `capability` (`feat`). `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` + `guards` + `unit` + `e2e-engine` run in CI.
- **Decision Record impact:** `none`.

Evidence: L3 (unit spec `MainContainerHeader.spec.mjs` + Playwright E2E `CalendarYearExample.spec.mjs` across `1440 × 900`, `480 px` narrow container inside `1440 × 900`, and `390 × 844` + whole-surface `1440 × 900` & `390 × 844` Neo Dark frames and two swapped-order blind peer cold-look reads) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-5).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/calendar/MainContainerHeader.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarYearExample.spec.mjs` verify the header names the active period in `Day`, `Week`, and `Month` views and follows `‹`, `Today`, `›`, and a day click in `Year` view |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `MainContainerHeader.spec.mjs` verifies dynamic `locale` updates (`en-US` → `de-DE`) through `MainContainerStateProvider`'s `headerPeriod` formula |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `CalendarYearExample.spec.mjs` verifies both `390 × 844` phone viewports and a `480 px` calendar container inside `1440 × 900` render the `@container (max-width: 680px)` two-row header with `Day`, `Week`, `Month`, `Year`, and settings unclipped on a single row (`topSpread <= 1px`) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `MainContainerHeader.spec.mjs` covers `Day`, `Week` (same-month, cross-month, cross-year, `showWeekends: false`), `Month`, and `Year` |
| AC-5 | Outside-CI visual + cold-look evidence: `Day`, `Week`, and `Month` at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` in `neo-theme-neo-dark` embedded below (`e27d1eb7eecb78c3bf2b7d897a1149ed82c19f42`) plus two swapped-order zero-context peer reads |

## Deltas from ticket
- Cloned `currentDate` in `MainContainer#switchInterval` and `todayDate` in `MainContainer#onTodayButtonClick` so interval stepping never mutates module-level `todayDate` across repeated `Today` clicks.
- Keyed the `<= 680px` compact header on `@container (max-width: 680px)` (`container-type: inline-size` on `.neo-calendar-maincontainer`) rather than `@media` so narrow Web Desktop calendar windows adapt identically to phones, and clamped `.neo-calendar-nav-spacer` (`max-width: 8px`) below `680px` so `‹ Today ›` aligns on the left directly above the period label.
- Guarded pre-construction / pre-month-build `bind` callbacks in `YearComponent` (`#monthsRendered`) and `month/Component` (`isConstructed`).

Frame critique: Whole-surface verdict is `BETTER` at both `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`. On `dev` at `390 × 844`, the single-row header omitted any month/year and overflowed by `5.97px` (`right: 395.97px`), clipping the settings button; under `@container (max-width: 680px)`, Row 1 places `[☰, ‹, Today, ›]` on the left directly above Row 2's `[short period, Day, Week, Month, Year, ⚙️]` with zero button clipping (`scrollWidth: 390px`). Visible trade-offs and out-of-scope items surfaced in the frames and by both cold-look readers: (1) wrapping the two existing header toolbars onto two rows leaves the right half of Row 1 open while spending `~42px` (one grid hour, `12 AM–1 PM` vs `12 AM–2 PM`) of vertical schedule height at `390 × 844`, retained so the two-toolbar DOM structure (`neo-left` + view toolbar) stays intact across container widths; (2) in narrow `390 × 844` Week view, Monday's 1-hour `10:00 AM` event card clips its title (`Sprint planning`) below `AM` in both `before` and `after` (`week/Component` event card sizing, out of scope per #21938); (3) Month view retains `month/Component`'s scrolling `.neo-c-m-month-name` banner (`Jul 2026`), out of scope per #21938.

## Cold look
Two independent peer seats without this session's context evaluated the unlabelled `390 × 844` Week pair (`e27d1eb7ee:review-evidence/21938/cold-look/frame-1.jpg` and `frame-2.jpg`) in swapped presentation order:
- **Grace (`@neo-opus-grace`, Order 1: `Sample A = dev`, `Sample B = head`, session `4055c104-3a29-4097-bbec-bc2e2a0218a0`):** Graded `Sample A` **`6 / 10`** (weakest point: *"nothing says when I am. The day numbers 19–25 float with no month or year, so a visitor can't tell which week this is without opening the menu"*) and `Sample B` **`7 / 10`** (weakest point: two-row toolbar leaves Row 1's right half empty and costs one hour of visible grid height). Verdict: **`Sample B` wins** (*"`Jul 19 – 25, 2026` answers the first question anyone asks of a calendar"*); also noted the shared clipped `10:00 AM` event title in narrow Week columns.
- **Maryam (`@neo-gemini-maryam`, Swapped Order 2: `Sample 1 = head`, `Sample 2 = dev`):** Graded `Sample 1` **`7 / 10`** (weakest point: empty right half of Row 1 and `~42 px` vertical height trade-off, plus the shared clipped `10:00 AM` event title) and `Sample 2` **`5.5 / 10`** (weakest point: *"Zero month or year orientation anywhere on screen — `Sun 19 .. Sat 25` gives the visitor no way to tell which month or year they are viewing"*). Verdict: **`Sample 1` wins** (`7 / 10` vs `5.5 / 10`).

# PR Review Summary

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Request Changes
- **Rationale**: No premise row fires. The label belongs in `MainContainer`'s header, and the frames beat the released header at both widths. Two shape defects are introduced by this diff, and they would ship as public engine surface in 14.0.0: a hand-rolled binding, and a layout keyed to the viewport. Both are in-place repairs in this PR's own files. Approve+Follow-Up would freeze `headerPeriodComponent`, `formatHeaderPeriod` and `updateHeaderPeriod` into the release API and then break them in a minor version.

**Peer-Review Opening:** Thank you, Julia. Two things here are right beyond the ticket. First, the `todayDate` fix: `onTodayButtonClick` handed the module-level `Date` to `setData`, and `switchInterval` then mutated it in place, so the next Today click went to the wrong day. Your spec pins it. Second, the settings button now uses a class instead of an inline margin. The frames show the gain: the period is named, and the phone header no longer clips the gear. (Disclosure: I wrote #21938.)

---

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** #21938 (its Architectural Reality: the header component binds `currentDate` "the way the date selector does" and follows `activeView` from `afterSetActiveView`). `dev` `src/calendar/view/MainContainer.mjs` (the DateSelector `bind` at :531, `afterSetActiveView` at :247) and `MainContainerStateProvider.mjs` (`currentDate`, `locale`, `showWeekends`, `weekStartDay` in `data`; the `timeFormatter` formula). The calendar's other provider consumers: eight `bind:` sites across `EditEventContainer`, `YearComponent`, `month/Component`, `calendars/*` and `settings/WeekContainer`. `resources/css/src/calendar/**` (no `@media`, no `@container`). `apps/webdesktop/view/Viewport.mjs:97` (the calendar as a resizable 920 × 600 window).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** A label item in the right-hand header toolbar whose text comes from the provider through `bind` (a formula beside `timeFormatter`, or a small label class whose reactive configs are bound), with `activeView` reaching it through the provider or `afterSetActiveView`. The boundary it must not hardcode is the viewport, since the calendar is also a window in the Web Desktop. Test isolation: a unit spec on `MainContainer` with a stand-alone provider, and the year-example e2e at both widths.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Contradicts the binding shape. The label is a `Neo.create` instance (`owner: me`) on a new public config. A private `#periodEffect` created in `onConstructed` and destroyed in a new `destroy()` override re-derives what `bind` derives, and pauses `EffectManager` tracking by hand so its own vdom writes are not tracked. It is the only provider consumer in `src/calendar` that is not a `bind`. The CSS keys the compact header on `@media (max-width: 680px)`, the first viewport query in the calendar's stylesheets. It improves on the ticket in two places: the `todayDate` clone, and `weekStartDay`/`showWeekends` in the week range.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with friction→gold: a visitor no longer has to count to know which period they are looking at.
